content.short: TON Validators are the decentralized nodes responsible for securing and processing transactions on the TON network.
content.description: TON Validators are a decentralized network of nodes that maintain the integrity and security of The Open Network (TON) through a Proof-of-Stake (PoS) consensus mechanism. These validators are responsible for processing transactions, creating new blocks, and ensuring that the network operates correctly and without censorship. By staking significant amounts of Toncoin, validators are incentivized to act in the network's best interest. The decentralized nature of the validator pool is what makes the TON blockchain robust, secure, and resilient to attacks or manipulation.
